01:27:48	Mislav | Ethlabs:	To summarize my view on the mutliple schemes: I don't have enough knowledge on cryptography to say whether or not lattices will have issues. I am inclined to trust the mathematicians here. 

But even if hashes are the solution, we have no guarantee that Apple, Google, and the rest of the relevant OS or hardware producers will choose the same hash based signatures as we did. 

Ethereum UX suffered for years due to the choice of the k1 curve and all of us who worked on product/tech for smart accounts have PTSD from it. 

The end result was big centralization where Privy/Dynamic and others took passkey sigs on their server and served the k1 sigs back to the chain - because the native solution was tricky/expensive. 

That's why I say I don't consider it a cryptography decision, but a product/ux decision.
